actual_api_defect_and_repair.defect: The supplied fixed-four-argument FFI declaration of Darwin variadic openat created a retained stage with mode0000 despite mode0600 requested. Observed in owned production execution, not inferred from primitive success.
actual_api_defect_and_repair.repair: Darwin arm64-specific FFI declaration occupies x3..x7 and puts mode in ninth fixed argument at stack[0]; creation is verified as0600 before writing. O_CLOEXEC uses Darwin fcntl.h value0x1000000 because Node/Bun omit the exported constant. Actual active descriptor F_GETFD tests assert FD_CLOEXEC.
